records.body:

Here if you need anything.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to three Wrenfield emails (email:f9ee7d5d, email:c00dd678, email:5fc365fc) and no tickets filed -- no signal of engagement. Starter plan, single admin. Silent accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A quick hand with your first project
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Following up on my note from yesterday -- I haven't heard back, so I want to make sure nothing is stuck on our side.

The simplest starting point in Wrenfield: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready for your team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Priya
